# About Federated Partners

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/about-federated-partners

Federated partners are host and guest partner administrators whose B2B
Federation request has been approved by both business partners. They have
established trust through the Zero Trust Partner Federation process.

On **Infrastructure > B2B Exchange > Federation > Partners > Federated
Partners**, administrators can add partners, filter the table, view configured
partners, and modify displayed columns. Each row can show the partner name,
the date trust was established, and status. The page lists **Active**, **Pause**,
and **Terminate** as partner-status values/actions.

The page also lets administrators view federated applications for a partner,
federate applications so they are eligible to share with host partners, and
navigate to Pending Requests to manage incoming and outgoing requests.
